catalysts.title: Blackwell Ultra Volume Scale & Vera Rubin Production Hand-Off
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: Management confirmed Vera Rubin platform in full production and Q3 guidance at $108B (+12% QoQ) driven by record data center backlog.
catalysts.description: Full production ramp of dual-die Blackwell Ultra systems and initial commercial shipment pipeline for next-generation Vera Rubin rack-scale architectures.

evidence.fact: Q2 FY2027 Data Center revenue surged to $89.02B (+117% YoY) with multi-quarter demand visibility stretching well into calendar 2027.

catalysts.title: NVLink Switch & Liquid-Cooled Rack System Densification
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: Hyperscaler deployments migrating from discrete PCIe/SXM cards to complete NVL72 turnkey liquid-cooled rack footprints.
catalysts.description: System-level monetization dramatically lifts average selling prices (ASPs) from $35K per GPU to over $3M per NVL72 liquid-cooled rack.

evidence.fact: Compute and Networking segments generated 72% segment operating margins as networking attachment rates hit record highs.

catalysts.title: Global Sovereign AI & National Supercomputing Procurement
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: Multi-billion-dollar government commitments across Europe, Japan, and the Middle East deploying sovereign LLM foundational models.
catalysts.description: National AI infrastructure projects creating durable non-hyperscaler demand pools that are less vulnerable to commercial cloud capex cycles.

evidence.fact: Management highlighted sovereign AI is scaling toward a low-double-digit percentage of total data center revenue.

catalysts.title: Utility Grid Interconnection & Power Density Bottlenecks
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: Utilities in Virginia, Texas, and Ireland requiring 24-48 month substation delivery queues for multi-hundred-megawatt campus expansions.
catalysts.description: Physical constraints on electrical grid infrastructure and high-voltage transformers delaying hyperscaler data center completions and GPU cluster turn-ons.

evidence.fact: Hyperscalers reported power availability as the primary gating factor for accelerating 2027 cluster commissioning.

catalysts.title: Hyperscaler In-House ASIC Disintermediation in High-Volume Inference
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: Broadcom custom silicon revenue growth (+42% YoY) powered by Google TPU v6 and Meta MTIA internal workload shifts.
catalysts.description: Cloud providers migrating predictable, latency-sensitive inference workloads to custom ASICs to suppress unit serving costs and margin transfer to NVIDIA.

evidence.fact: Broadcom and Marvell reported accelerated demand for custom XPU accelerators across top-4 hyperscalers.

catalysts.title: Geopolitical Export Restrictions on Advanced Computing & CoWoS Packaging
catalysts.probabilityAnchor: Ongoing Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) reviews regarding compute density thresholds and third-country transshipment enforcement.
catalysts.description: Further tightening of performance density thresholds could restrict sales of modified accelerators to Chinese data centers and cloud proxies.

evidence.fact: China revenue share stabilized at single digits of Data Center revenue following prior Commerce Department restrictions.
